rationale: b_continue is a local execution gate. Its semantics are clear only when it is strictly function-local and unidirectional. It governs execution flow across all phases of a function: validation, business logic, exception handling, and cleanup.
remediation: Add b_continue = True at function start. Set to False on errors, never reset to True. Gate phases with 'if b_continue:'.

guidance.explanation: The correct version initializes b_continue=True and uses it to gate phases. The incorrect version has no error-gating mechanism, making control flow implicit.
